ns2:course.label: Seminar on Security
ns2:course.description: Technology and security issues are analyzed through preparation of reports on a weekly seminar chosen from a regular seminar offering or an alternative approved list. Topics include technology of domestic and international security and the regional and international contexts that influence the nature of security problems. Same as GLBL 483. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 2 hours. Junior standing is required. Prerequisite: Composition I.
